programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Searched & Seized
programme.desc: Every year, Jennifer and her friend Miles Wexford participate in the organization of an auction of goods seized by the police. The night of the auction, Miles is found dead in his store.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
programme.desc: Antiques guru Jennifer Shannon (Lori Loughlin) investigates a murder after an old college friend becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: We Grown Now
programme.desc: In 1992 best friends Malik and Eric traverse the city of Chicago, looking to escape the mundaneness of school and the hardships of growing up in public housing. They soon find their unbreakable bond challenged when a tragedy shakes their community.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: All That Glitters
programme.desc: A killer pursues a woman (Lori Loughlin) after she buys a storage unit that contains something valuable.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: When Peter Parker asks for help from Doctor Strange, the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Jurassic World Dominion
programme.desc: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, Biosyn operatives attempt to track down Maisie Lockwood, while Dr Ellie Sattler investigates a genetically engineered swarm of giant insects.

programme.title: The School of Rock
programme.desc: Fired from his group and desperate for money, a guitarist (Jack Black) poses as a teacher for students who play in a school band.

programme.title: Polite Society
programme.desc: A martial artist-in-training believes she must save her older sister from her impending marriage. After enlisting the help of her friends, she tries to pull off the most ambitious of all wedding heists in the name of independence and sisterhood.

programme.title: The Dreadful
programme.desc: In medieval England, Anne and her domineering mother-in-law struggle to survive on the outskirts of society. When a man from Anne's past returns from war, a curse begins to take shape that threatens to destroy them all.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favorite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

programme.title: Greedy People
programme.desc: Residents of a small island town navigate a murder and the discovery of a million dollars, a series of increasingly bad decisions upend the once peaceful community.

programme.title: Rush for Your Life
programme.desc: Journalism student Tasha goes undercover as a sorority pledge to expose the people responsible for the death of a student the prior year. She quickly finds herself completing dangerous hazing rituals to secure a spot in the sorority.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Wedding Dress
programme.desc: Sleuth Jennifer Shannon (Lori Loughlin) and Detective Lynwood (Barclay Hope) investigate a decades-old case involving the disappearance of a groom.

programme.title: Little jesus
programme.desc: Tells the story of Jean who pins his hopes of recovering from his wounds on a miracle: his ten-year-old son. He is convinced that Loulou is the new Messiah.

programme.title: Triumph: Rock & Roll Machine
programme.desc: The story of underdog Canadian rock band Triumph, which rose to stardom in the 1970s and '80s only to disappear at the height of its fame.

programme.title: All We Imagine as Light
programme.desc: Nurse Prabha's daily life in Mumbai takes an unexpected turn when a surprise present arrives from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, faces frustration in her quest to secure a private spot in the city to be intimate with her partner.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Branded a traitor, an elite intelligence agent (Tom Cruise) investigates a failed Prague mission to retrieve a computer disk.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's quest to solve his parents' disappearance puts him on a collision course with a scientist's deadly alter ego, the Lizard.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Greater conflict lies ahead for Spider-Man, with the emergence of Electro, a foe far more powerful than he is and the return of his old friend, Harry Osborn.
Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father starts him down a path of vengeance, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

programme.title: Can I Get a Witness
programme.desc: In a not so distant future, there is a reality where in order to save the planet, "death is everyone's job," with 50-year-olds taking the sacrifice, while teenage artists need to document it.

programme.title: Perfectly a Strangeness
programme.desc: In the incandescence of an unknown desert, three donkeys discover an abandoned astronomical observatory and the universe.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Wanda becomes a reporter for the Howler; Brent takes guitar lessons.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Brent tries to prove he is the biggest Saskatchewan Roughriders fan.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash wants to make things right with Amira after their lives are turned upside down once again.

programme.title: The Manny
programme.desc: Morgan stalks his way into the lives of busy social media influencer Lani and her son, Jaylen, to become their male nanny; as Morgan shows himself to be someone who is too good to be true, he meddles with Lani and Jaylen's lives.

programme.title: Strong Fathers, Strong Daughters
programme.desc: When a wealthy businessman learns of his daughter's engagement, he struggles to give up control and trust God with her future.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Mask Murder
programme.desc: When Jennifer buys a storage locker at auction, she discovers a dead body inside -- along with a mask matching the deceased woman.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Picture a Murder
programme.desc: Jenn gets the photos in an antique camera from the estate of a recently deceased and seemingly wealthy photography enthusiast printed, and one of the pictures leads her to believe that the man's death was anything but accidental.

programme.title: Reagan
programme.desc: From the glitter of Hollywood to the world stage, Ronald Reagan overcomes the odds to become the 40th President of the United States.

programme.title: Good Wife's Guide to Murder
programme.desc: Kate must find her husband's killer in order to clear her own name.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programme.title: No One Will Save You

programme.title: Sanctuary

programme.desc: Will begins to experience strange visions that are connected to the Cult of Kali; Magnus has difficulty with finding the solution to their problems.

programme.title: Dolphin Tale

programme.desc: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

programme.title: Austin Powers in Goldmember

programme.title: Ghostbusters

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, four women (Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones, Kate McKinnon) prepare for an epic battle as mischievous ghosts start to wreak havoc in New York.

programme.title: Caddyshack

programme.title: Sweetbitter

programme.title: Sweetbitter
programme.desc: When Tess forgets her wallet at the restaurant, she goes back to discover what happens after-hours; Simone teaches her about the coding of tongues, leading Tess to become even more enthralled by Simone.

programme.title: Mommy
programme.desc: A peculiar neighbor (Suzanne Clément) offers hope to a recent widow (Anne Dorval) who is struggling to raise a teenager (Antoine-Olivier Pilon) who is unpredictable and, sometimes, violent.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: The team must find Kali in order to prevent tidal waves from killing millions; Will fights for his life in Mumbai.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Will is having trouble recovering after his experience with Kali, but the team soon finds that insomnia is the least of his problems; Helen discovers an unbelievable gift from an equally unbelievable source.

programme.title: Free Willy
programme.desc: An abandoned boy (Jason James Richter) with a chip on his shoulder befriends an ill-fated killer whale at a water park.

programme.title: Cooking With Stella
programme.desc: A woman cooks for clients and tries to keep her thefts of food and money from being discovered.

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story

programme.title: Sweetbitter

programme.title: Barababor

programme.title: La baie des Kangourous

programme.title: Millie la magnifique
programme.desc: Quand Miles rate la chance de voir un magnifique arc-en-ciel, Millie cherche à en recréer un pour son petit frère dans sa maison.

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille

programme.desc: Le curé Labelle a entraîné dans son sillage des milliers de colons qui ont contribué à développer les Laurentides; artisan de l'essor industriel du Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean, Julien-Édouard-Alfred Dubuc est pourtant une figure méconnue des Québécois.

programme.title: Hiroshima: minute par minute
programme.desc: Minute par minute, découvrez Hiroshima comme jamais auparavant. Avec des historiens de renom, des archives captivantes et une voix envoûtante. La guerre, la bombe, le moment qui a changé l'histoire.

programme.title: Harry Wild
programme.desc: Harry, Fergus et Lola fêtent la fin des examens de Fergus au pub de June, mais une tempête force les clients à rester à l'intérieur le temps que les routes soient à nouveau praticables.

programme.title: Coeurs noirs
programme.desc: Afin de récupérer Sab, les 45 doivent protéger Zaïd en éliminant un survivant de Qalb Aswad qui veut le dénoncer à Daesh.

programme.title: Je suis là: les proches aidants en santé mentale
programme.desc: Jusqu'où peut-on aller pour aider un être cher souffrant de troubles mentaux ? Avec empathie, Monic Néron et Paul Arcand donnent la parole aux proches qui se dévouent chaque jour, tout en cherchant eux-mêmes à garder la tête hors de l'eau.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On expérimente avec un miroir concave, un radiateur et des rayons infrarouges, on s'amuse avec un train électrique transportant une citerne, et il faut découvrir à l'aide d'indices quelle mousse végétale la Boîte contient.

programme.title: Kebec
programme.desc: Le curé Labelle a entraîné dans son sillage des milliers de colons qui ont contribué à développer les Laurentides; artisan de l'essor industriel du Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean, Julien-Édouard-Alfred Dubuc est pourtant une figure méconnue des Québécois.

programme.title: Je suis là: les proches aidants en santé mentale
programme.desc: Paul et Néron plongent dans les réalités de Nicole, Jean-Hugues, Denis et Sylvie : crises, P-38, hospitalisation et démarches incessantes pour aider un enfant malade. Des parents épuisés, un système rigide, et des histoires qui se répondent.

programme.title: Ammonite
programme.desc: La paléontologue réputée Mary Anning travaille seule à vendre des fossiles communs aux touristes pour soutenir sa mère malade, mais une offre d'emploi fortuite change sa vie lorsqu'un visiteur l'engage pour s'occuper de sa femme.

programme.title: Sous les paillettes, la rage : une histoire du Drag
programme.desc: Du rituel ancien à Drag Race, le drag mêle art et militantisme. De William Dorsey Swann à RuPaul, ce documentaire explore un siècle de résistance, de fierté et d'impact culturel LGBTQ+.

programme.title: BooSnoo!
programme.desc: BooSnoo va sous l'eau où tout l'attend, des palourdes chantantes aux méduses flottantes.

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille
programme.desc: Chickaletta est coincée sur un drone en fuite et de mystérieux papillons provoquent le chaos tout autour d'"Adventure Bay" ; le maire Humdinger vole la statue de Chickaletta.

programme.title: Mumfie
programme.desc: Ce soir est la nuit du grand spectacle de chêne; une fois par an, des lucioles illuminent l'arbre majestueux à la tombée de la nuit; tout le monde est ravi d'y aller, jusqu'à ce qu'ils se rendent compte que Boo ne peut pas les accompagner.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Alors que Simon et Ferdinand se disputent, Gaspard les interrompt pour leur montrer une bille; il l'a trouvée à côté d'une grosse pierre et il est persuadé qu'il y en a plein d'autres en dessous; ils y retournent, mais la pierre est bien trop lourde.

programme.title: Bing

programme.title: Tulipop

programme.title: Patamuse
programme.desc: À travers une série d'histoires de trois minutes, le narrateur aide le jeune spectateur à découvrir un monde amusant, avec toutes sortes d'animaux en argile grâce à une large palette de couleurs.
